answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

一张跨栏宽的组合图 Figure B.1:26 个年份槽(1996–2021),深蓝柱为「Speed of income convergence」读左轴 -1…8「percentage points」;绿线为「Trade participation」读右轴 40…160「(100=1996)」,即双值轴+柱线混合。柱内还有第二种浅蓝填色(2008、2009、2020),Note 说明它表示「a contribution of negative growth in high-income economies」,图例里没有这一项。2021 柱在零线以下,1998 槽根本没有柱。标题写在整幅宽的实心蓝色横幅里,轴标题竖排,年份刻度斜排,图例在图下,下面是 Source/Note 小字。

**定位一个值难在哪**

7.7:它是 2009 年柱子的顶端,但顶端那截是浅蓝的。要唯一定位需要三个标签——年份 2009、系列名 Speed of income convergence、以及只在图下 Note 里出现的「light blue fill」;图例给不出这个名字。而且没有任何数字印在图上,只能靠 1 个单位间隔的横线内插。

**不确定的**

线上的点全靠像素换算:128、138、125 分别归到 2003、2004、2009 属于推断,相邻年份差常不足 5%。2020 柱是否整根为浅蓝、1998 是零还是缺失,都看不确切。

heading.title: Positive correlation between low- and middle-income economies' convergence speed and trade participation, 1996-2021

axes.serves: only the green Trade participation line
bars and line share the year slots

worked_example.why_hard: Light-blue top segment unnamed in legend; only Note defines it; left-axis gridlines are 1 point apart.

components.evidence: left axis '-1..8 Speed of income convergence (percentage points)', right axis '40..160 Trade participation (100=1996)'
blue bars per year with a continuous green line drawn over them in the same panel
2008 and 2009 bars carry a light blue segment sitting on top of the dark blue part
Note: 'The light blue fill indicates a contribution of negative growth in high-income economies.'
the 2021 bar hangs below the zero line; lowest left tick reads '-1'
right axis lowest tick is '40', not zero, and is not cut
'(percentage points)' sits in the left axis title; bars carry no printed numbers
both 'Speed of income convergence (percentage points)' and 'Trade participation (100=1996)' set vertically
year labels 1996 ... 2021 are turned about 45 degrees under the axis
'Speed of income convergence' swatch and 'Trade participation' line sit in a row under the plot
'Source: Authors' calculations, based on World Bank data...' and 'Note: The figure displays...' below the plot
faint horizontal rules at each left tick; no vertical rules in the plot area
the 1998 slot between the 1997 and 1999 bars is empty, no bar drawn
superscript markers in body text: 'global poverty rate1' and 'Cerdeiro and Komaromi, 2021).2'

new_components.evidence: 'Figure B.1: Positive correlation between...' printed white on a solid blue band spanning the figure width

new_components.name: segment_meaning_only_in_note
new_components.evidence: legend lists only two series; the light blue bar segment is defined solely in the Note text

the peak of the Trade participation line, 2008
the top of the 2009 bar, i.e. the light blue segment's upper edge

a Trade participation line point around 2004; could equally be 2010
the 2021 bar, drawn below the zero line
the 2009 trough of the Trade participation line

answer.hardest_step_why: 全图无数字标注;右轴刻度间隔20,125与128之差仅2.4%,远小于刻度;左轴间隔1,-0.2与2.7也须内插。

examples.quote: Left axis 'Speed of income convergence (percentage points)' -1 to 8; right axis 'Trade participation (100=1996)' 40 to 160; bars plus one line
examples.why: 一个面板两套值轴、柱与线共存,取值必须记录读的是哪根轴、哪种标记,现有流程不区分。

examples.quote: Note: 'The light blue fill indicates a contribution of negative growth in high-income economies.'
examples.why: 浅蓝段的含义只在注释里,图例不含该项;颜色携带的属性须进入键。

examples.quote: 'Figure B.1: Positive correlation between low- and middle-income economies' convergence speed and trade participation, 1996-2021' in a solid blue banner
examples.why: 编号、标题、年份区间同处一条满宽色带内,标题块位置与样式需成为独立字段。

examples.quote: the 2021 bar hangs below the zero line; left ticks read -1, 0, 1 ... 8 while the right axis begins at 40
examples.why: 负值柱、零线以及右轴非零起点的组合,当前样式维度无法生成。
